name: bodyweight standing one arm row
description: A standing one arm row with your body weight, leaning back from a wall bar and pulling yourself in. Good for the upper back and lats.
instructions: Stand facing a wall bar with your feet near its base.
Hold a rung at chest height with one hand.
Lean back until your arm is straight and your body is in a line.
Row your chest toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
